node_01_crm.title: 360° Athlete Profile & Legal Compliance (CRM)
node_01_crm.short_desc: Artron CRM is a multi-layered, dynamic database enabling unified digital management for all member types — from elite professional athletes to casual guests, family units, and corporate groups. The system automatically enforces legal and medical compliance, shielding your enterprise from liability.
node_01_crm.hint_chip_select: [ SELECT AN ACCORDION CHIP ON THE LEFT PANEL TO VIEW FULL TELEMETRY ]

sub_items.label: 1. Multi-Profile Hierarchy (Families, Parents & Children)
sub_items.functional_desc: Legal and financial linking of parent and child profiles within a unified ecosystem. Allows parents to manage memberships, wallets, and booking histories for dependents.
sub_items.permissions: Club administrators can delegate full financial management rights to parents while restricting dependents to workout plans and check-ins.
sub_items.business_value: Simplifies launch of family subscription tiers, boosts LTV (Lifetime Value), and significantly increases customer retention.

sub_items.label: 2. Corporate Groups, Students & Friend Associations
sub_items.functional_desc: Centralized management of B2B corporate contracts, university partnerships, and group rates with automated invoicing and cap enforcement.
sub_items.permissions: Admin retains rights to restrict corporate visit hours, define usage caps, and automate monthly B2B telemetry reports.
sub_items.business_value: Unlocks a reliable B2B sales pipeline, ensures guaranteed upfront recurring revenue (MRR), and accelerates bulk onboarding.

sub_items.label: 3. Professional Athletes vs Amateur Fitness Members
sub_items.functional_desc: Strict segmentation of club members based on athletic goals. Pro athletes access advanced biometrics, while casual members enjoy streamlined onboarding.
sub_items.permissions: Coaches receive view-only access to assigned pro group telemetry and medical safety data under strict privacy governance.
sub_items.business_value: Maintains high athletic standards and elite coaching prestige without alienating mass fitness members.

sub_items.label: 4. VIP Members, Guests & Trial Visits
sub_items.functional_desc: Instant digital onboarding for single-day guests, VIP clientele, and trial visitors with temporary dynamic QR/NFC access keys.
sub_items.permissions: VIP members receive priority facility reservation rights; guest passes grant time-restricted 24-hour turnstile entry.
sub_items.business_value: Drives premium brand perception, elevates VIP retention, and increases trial-to-membership conversion by 35%.

sub_items.label: 5. Medical Validity & Legal Compliance (Compliance & Safety)
sub_items.functional_desc: Automated verification and tracking of Form 100 medical clearances, liability waivers, and digital consent signatures.
sub_items.permissions: System automatically revokes facility turnstile and booking privileges if medical clearance or waiver expires.
sub_items.business_value: Protects club management from legal liability and financial penalties while reducing insurance risk exposure by 80%.

node_02_blueprint.title: Facility Blueprint & Smart Turnstiles (Digital Twin & Access)
node_02_blueprint.short_desc: Complete facility infrastructure visualization, IoT sensors, and Edge access controllers. Delivers sub-50ms turnstile unlocking via RFID, NFC, and dynamic QR passes, alongside real-time occupancy heatmaps.

sub_items.label: 1. Real-Time RFID, NFC & Dynamic QR Turnstile Monitoring
sub_items.functional_desc: Direct binary TCP/Socket relays connect to physical edge controllers for instant (<50ms) turnstile actuation. Supports RFID smartcards, NFC devices, and dynamic QR passes with Anti-Screenshot and Anti-Passback safeguards.
sub_items.permissions: Facility administrators have full live audit streaming, selective card revocation, and remote 5-second pulse release overrides.
sub_items.business_value: Completely eliminates unpaid tailgating and shared credentials, dissolving reception queues and slashing front-desk overhead by 40%.

sub_items.label: 2. Live Capacity & Zone Occupancy Heatmap
sub_items.functional_desc: Real-time sector density visualization across fitness zones (Cardio, Free Weights, CrossFit, Pool). Heatmap refreshes every 60 seconds to display peak congestion dynamics.
sub_items.permissions: Facility managers can set zonal headcount thresholds and receive automated trigger alerts whenever capacity exceeds 85%.
sub_items.business_value: Distributes attendance into off-peak hours, prevents equipment bottlenecking, and raises Member Satisfaction (CSAT) by 28%.

sub_items.label: 3. Emergency Lockdown / Evacuation Protocols
sub_items.functional_desc: Single-click fail-safe override to release all turnstiles, electromagnetic locks, and emergency fire exits instantaneously (Fail-Safe Evacuation Mode).
sub_items.permissions: Evacuation execution is restricted to certified Security Officers and Master Admins via two-factor biometric confirmation.
sub_items.business_value: Guarantees 100% compliance with international ISO and municipal fire safety regulations, mitigating catastrophic legal liability.

sub_items.label: 4. Multi-Zone Differential Access (Pool, Spa, VIP Lounges, Lockers)
sub_items.functional_desc: Tier-based granular zone gating. Smart Locker assignment synchronized with primary credentials and time-bound restricted access (e.g., Morning 07:00-12:00 tariff).
sub_items.permissions: Tier access rules, daily schedules, and time boundaries are configured instantly via isolated Row-Level Security policies.
sub_items.business_value: Monetizes premium zones (Spa, VIP recovery), accelerates upsell conversion, and prevents unauthorized zone breach.

node_03_staff.title: Staff, Trainers & Labor Log (Order №01-15/ნ Compliance)
node_03_staff.short_desc: Full human resources and operational logistics for sports facilities: strict compliance with Georgian Labor Order №01-15/ნ via automated timekeeping ledgers, trainer schedule hubs, personal training tracking, and split-commission billing.

sub_items.label: 1. Labor Order №01-15/ნ Automated Attendance Ledger
sub_items.functional_desc: Full automation of Georgian Labor Safety requirements and Order №01-15/ნ. Turnstile timestamps record check-in/out times, medical leave codes, paid time off, and overtime hours automatically.
sub_items.permissions: HR directors and chief accountants have exclusive rights to edit log discrepancies, attach certified medical files, and generate inspection-ready exports.
sub_items.business_value: Prevents labor inspectorate fines, reduces administrative timesheet processing by 90%, and ensures 100% statutory transparency.

sub_items.label: 2. Trainer Hub, Schedules & Personal Session Log
sub_items.functional_desc: Interactive calendar engine for individual coaching and group class scheduling. One-tap electronic session sign-off (+/- visit decrement) and athlete progression telemetry.
sub_items.permissions: Trainers access an isolated mobile workspace to manage assigned clients and availability without exposure to proprietary financial data.
sub_items.business_value: Boosts coach productivity by 35%, eliminates unbilled ghost sessions, and maximizes member retention rates.

sub_items.label: 3. Automated Split-Commission Calculation & Payroll
sub_items.functional_desc: Automated percentage accruals on personal training package sales and completed sessions. Real-time split accounting between facility margin and coach commission.
sub_items.permissions: Owners configure customizable commission brackets (Fixed, Tiered, Performance-incentivized) for each staff seniority tier.
sub_items.business_value: Generates instantaneous month-end payroll sheets, slashes human accounting errors to zero, and aligns trainer motivation with facility revenue.

sub_items.label: 4. Trainer Certification, Rating & Evaluation Matrix
sub_items.functional_desc: Verified digital repository for international accreditations, certifications, and coaching tenure. Post-workout feedback feeds and member satisfaction scores.
sub_items.permissions: Automated system notifications warn management when certifications near expiration, generating periodic staff KPI scorecards.
sub_items.business_value: Fortifies premium facility reputation, retains top-tier coaching talent, and elevates package conversion by 40% on top-rated trainers.

node_04_mobile.title: Athlete Mobile Ecosystem (Athlete Mobile OS)
node_04_mobile.short_desc: Athlete-centric native mobile application (iOS/Android): instantaneous turnstile entry with dynamic anti-screenshot QR pass, online membership renewal with 14-day statutory return, and real-time class booking.

sub_items.label: 1. Instant Dynamic QR Pass & 1-Tap Turnstile Authorization
sub_items.functional_desc: One-tap dynamic pass screen upon opening the app. QR rotates every 30 seconds with encrypted tokens, remaining fully operative offline during network interruptions.
sub_items.permissions: Members monitor their remaining credits and historical check-in logs. Capturing a screenshot instantly invalidates the active QR token.
sub_items.business_value: Zero entry queue friction, 100% elimination of plastic card manufacturing costs, and frictionless user onboarding.

sub_items.label: 2. Multi-Profile Family Accounts & Dependent Passes
sub_items.functional_desc: Single-app instant switching between family profiles (spouses, children). Real-time parental push notifications upon dependent facility entry and exit.
sub_items.permissions: Parents retain full financial custody over pass purchases, class enrollments (Swimming, Gymnastics, Martial Arts), and medical clearances.
sub_items.business_value: Increases family package sales by 45%, safeguards child privacy compliance, and establishes long-term household retention.

sub_items.label: 3. Live Class & Personal Trainer Booking Engine
sub_items.functional_desc: Live scheduling for group studios (Yoga, Pilates, Spinning) with real-time seat counters. Integrated coach calendar for booking one-on-one sessions.
sub_items.permissions: Users can cancel bookings according to facility rules (e.g., up to 2 hours prior) or join dynamic automated waitlists.
sub_items.business_value: Maximizes studio and trainer capacity utilization (92%+), slashing No-Show session dropouts by 60%.

sub_items.label: 4. Instant Pass Renewal & 14-Day Statutory Return Guarantee
sub_items.functional_desc: Seamless checkout via Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Georgian banking gateways. Fully compliant with consumer rights legislation (14-day unconditional withdrawal).
sub_items.permissions: Members can initiate subscription freeze periods and request 1-tap refunds directly from the app interface within statutory terms.
sub_items.business_value: Automates 50% of recurring renewals, builds unyielding consumer trust, and passes App Store / Google Play review criteria flawlessly.

node_05_loyalty.title: Loyalty System, Cashback & Points Bank (Loyalty & Points Bank)
node_05_loyalty.short_desc: Powerful engine for customer retention and lifetime value expansion: Artron Coins digital wallet, automated cashback on purchases, dynamic VIP tier gamification, and centralized points exchange bank.

sub_items.label: 1. Centralized Points Bank & Artron Coins Digital Wallet
sub_items.functional_desc: Automatically accumulates Artron loyalty coins on every gym check-in, retail purchase, and class completion. Points can be redeemed for membership renewals, bar products, or personal coaching passes.
sub_items.permissions: Administrator configures exchange rates (e.g., 100 Points = 1 GEL), point expiration countdowns, and automated motivational SMS notifications.
sub_items.business_value: Boosts member engagement by 32%, incentivizes repeat visits, and locks in long-term customer loyalty through gamified wallet equity.

sub_items.label: 2. Dynamic Loyalty Tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum)
sub_items.functional_desc: Automated status progression driven by member tenure, visit frequency, and cumulative spend. Higher tiers unlock higher cashback percentages and exclusive facility perks.
sub_items.permissions: Club manager defines qualification thresholds (spend volumes, active months) and grants customized tier privileges with zero manual overhead.
sub_items.business_value: Increases Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) by 40% through gamification and secures elite VIP customer loyalty.

sub_items.label: 3. Viral Referral Engine & Automated Incentive Cashback
sub_items.functional_desc: Generates unique referral invitation links and promo codes in the mobile app. Both the referring member and the new invitee receive instant bonus balance upon signup and subscription purchase.
sub_items.permissions: Anti-fraud algorithms verify identity uniqueness and automatically credit bonus funds upon transaction settlement.
sub_items.business_value: Reduces Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) by 65% by tapping into organic word-of-mouth member invitations.

sub_items.label: 4. Digital Gift Vouchers & Partner Marketplace Rewards
sub_items.functional_desc: Electronic gift voucher purchase and dispatch via SMS/Email. Direct integration with external commercial partners (sports retailers, wellness clinics, spas) for cross-promotional vouchers.
sub_items.permissions: Instant single-use voucher code verification at front-desk and automated ledger settlement.
sub_items.business_value: Generates upfront prepaid holiday revenue and expands the facility's regional B2B ecosystem.

node_06_pos.title: Point of Sale & Inventory Depletion Engine (Marketplace & POS)
node_06_pos.short_desc: Specialized POS system for reception counters, fitness bars, supplements, and gear shops. Instant barcode scanning, real-time inventory depletion, supplier ledger management, and split-tender payment flows.

sub_items.label: 1. Ultra-Fast Touchscreen POS Terminal for Front-Desk & Bar
sub_items.functional_desc: Optimized touch catalog, rapid barcode scanner support, and 3-second order processing with digital receipt dispatch. Links sales directly to member profiles.
sub_items.permissions: Cashier/barista roles with fast checkout, custom discounts, and shift closing (X/Z Reports) with immutable cash register audits.
sub_items.business_value: Eliminates front-desk queues, triples cashier throughput, and expands daily bar revenue by 25%.

sub_items.label: 2. Automated Real-Time Stock Depletion & Recipe Deductions
sub_items.functional_desc: Instantly recalculates warehouse stocks on every transaction. Supports recipe-based ingredient depletion (e.g., protein shake recipes) and cycle audits.
sub_items.permissions: Warehouse manager executes planned cycle counts, logs discrepancies, and auto-recomputes weighted average costs.
sub_items.business_value: 100% prevention of stock leakage and unexplained shrinkage with absolute inventory audit accuracy.

sub_items.label: 3. Supplier Management & Critical Stock Alert Engine
sub_items.functional_desc: Waybill imports, cost calculation, and automated push/SMS/email alerts whenever item counts drop below safety stock thresholds.
sub_items.permissions: Purchasing director manages supplier agreements, purchase orders, and payable schedules.
sub_items.business_value: Zero stockouts on bestselling items and enhanced purchasing leverage with verified supplier data.

sub_items.label: 4. Split-Tender Combined Payment Engine (Cash, Card, Wallet)
sub_items.functional_desc: Split payment support: partial card charge, partial points redemption, and wallet balances. Prepaid account deposit top-ups for frictionless orders.
sub_items.permissions: Financial ledger automatically splits and routes funds to tax registers and internal accounting batches.
sub_items.business_value: Maximum payment flexibility for members, upfront float capital from deposits, and seamless ledger balancing.

node_07_analytics.title: Artificial Intelligence, Churn Prediction & BI (AI Analytics & BI)
node_07_analytics.short_desc: The central analytical brain for facility leadership: real-time financial and operational KPI dashboards, ML churn risk forecasting (0-100%), automated win-back reactivation workflows, and market capacity optimization.

sub_items.label: 1. Central KPI Dashboard (MRR, ARR, ARPU, LTV, Retention Rate)
sub_items.functional_desc: Real-time visibility into financial health, recurring revenue (MRR/ARR), active member net growth, ARPU, LTV, and historical period comparisons.
sub_items.permissions: Executive-level access to budget vs actual variance, multi-branch benchmarks, and predictive financial forecast models.
sub_items.business_value: 100% data-backed executive decisions, precision budgeting, and a 25% increase in operational profitability.

sub_items.label: 2. AI Churn Prediction — Machine Learning Risk Scoring (0-100%)
sub_items.functional_desc: ML models analyze behavioral anomalies and check-in drop-in-frequency, assigning an individual 0-100% churn risk score to every member 15-30 days before lapsing.
sub_items.permissions: Automated preventive triggers: motivational push alerts, free coach assessment bookings, or front-desk retention tasks for 80%+ risk scores.
sub_items.business_value: A 5% reduction in churn rate expands overall gym profits by 25% to 95% through compounded lifetime value.

sub_items.label: 3. Automated Win-Back Campaigns (Lapsed: 14-30d, 30-60d, 90+d)
sub_items.functional_desc: Lapsed member segmentation: Fresh Lapsed (14-30d), Medium Risk (30-60d), and Lost Customers (90+d). Automated multi-channel SMS/Push reactivation with GoSMS integration.
sub_items.permissions: Campaign ROI tracking: A/B testing of incentives (-15% discount vs +7 free days vs free PT trial) and Cost per Win-Back vs CAC comparisons.
sub_items.business_value: Reactivating an ex-member is 5-7x cheaper than acquiring a new customer, recovering 18-25% of lapsed members at minimal expense.

sub_items.label: 4. Market Analytics, Demographic Breakdown & Off-Peak Optimization
sub_items.functional_desc: Facility traffic heatmaps identifying off-peak windows. Demographic segmentation by age, gender, and membership tier popularity.
sub_items.permissions: Pricing and demand elasticity controls: dynamically configure Happy Hour and off-peak tariffs to redistribute attendance.
sub_items.business_value: Maximizes facility and equipment utilization (90%+ peak/off-peak balance) while optimizing average yield.

node_08_security.title: Security, Data Governance & SLA (Security & Legal Shield)
node_08_security.short_desc: 100% compliance with Georgian Personal Data Protection Law and European GDPR standards. AES-256-GCM column-level encryption for National IDs, biometric safeguards, automated 14-day data purge, and immutable 3-year statutory tax ledger archival.

sub_items.label: 1. AES-256-GCM Column-Level Encryption for National IDs (PII)
sub_items.functional_desc: National IDs and sensitive personal identity fields are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. Passwords use Argon2/Bcrypt hashing, and payment card processing is fully isolated under PCI-DSS compliance.
sub_items.permissions: Cryptographic key rotation and zero-trust permission walls prevent unauthorized staff from viewing unencrypted national identification numbers.
sub_items.business_value: 100% legal immunity, zero risk of PII breaches, and maximum member trust in platform integrity.

sub_items.label: 2. 14-Day Automated Data Purge Protocol (Right to be Forgotten)
sub_items.functional_desc: When an account deletion request is triggered via the mobile app or web, member personal data is purged within 15 calendar days. Health records and biometric photos are permanently deleted within 5 days.
sub_items.permissions: Automated background cron service (Automated System Data Purge) handles irrevocable destruction with an immutable audit certificate.
sub_items.business_value: Guarantees immediate compliance with Apple App Store, Google Play Account Deletion guidelines, and GDPR mandates.

sub_items.label: 3. Immutable 3-Year Statutory Tax Ledger & Financial Archival
sub_items.functional_desc: In compliance with the Tax Code of Georgia, financial ledgers, transaction records, and invoice receipts are preserved in a secure, tamper-proof archive for 3 years.
sub_items.permissions: Even after customer profile deletion, historical financial transactions remain anonymized and locked for tax audits.
sub_items.business_value: Zero tax audit penalties, audit-ready financial ledgers, and flawless accounting compliance.

sub_items.label: 4. Multi-Tenant Row-Level Security (RLS) & Zero-Trust Architecture
sub_items.functional_desc: Strict database-level multi-tenant isolation via Row-Level Security (RLS). No facility or federation can ever view or leak another tenant's metrics.
sub_items.permissions: Granular RBAC roles, WebAuthn/2FA biometric login safeguards, IP allow-listing, and real-time anomalous activity defense.
sub_items.business_value: Enterprise-grade cyber resilience, zero insider fraud, and unbreakable tenant isolation.

node_09_core_init.title: Sports OS Gateway & Onboarding Hub (Gateway & Control Console)
node_09_core_init.short_desc: Artron is the central operating system for industry leaders (Federations, Gyms, Swimming Pools, and Studios). Governed by the 9-node EnneaCore architecture, 1-click tenant onboarding, and authorized operator access.

sub_items.label: 1. Sports Entity Primary Onboarding & Core Provisioning
sub_items.functional_desc: 5-minute rapid onboarding for gyms, pools, studios, and federations. Frictionless database migration for members, coaches, and subscription plans from Excel/CSV.
sub_items.permissions: Guided onboarding wizard, automated initial configuration, and immediate assignment of a dedicated account manager.
sub_items.business_value: Zero-day downtime during platform migration and instant go-live operational launch.

sub_items.label: 2. Instant Sandbox Demo Environment Initiation
sub_items.functional_desc: Explore complete platform capabilities in an isolated Sandbox playground with simulated turnstile readers, visit logs, and live telemetry generation.
sub_items.permissions: Unrestricted sandbox simulation with 1-click test dataset reset and scenario simulation.
sub_items.business_value: 100% stakeholder confidence before financial commitment through hands-on capability validation.

sub_items.label: 3. Authorized Operator Console Login & Access Hub
sub_items.functional_desc: Secure role-tailored workstation login for registered facility owners, general managers, reception staff, and medical personnel.
sub_items.permissions: Session token security, active device monitoring, WebAuthn passkey authentication, and instantaneous global logout.
sub_items.business_value: Personalized internal dashboard layouts for every employee role, elevating staff operational speed by 60%.

sub_items.label: 4. One-Time Temporary OTP Visitor Gateway
sub_items.functional_desc: Instant verification and temporary portal access for test visitors, prospective partners, and external auditors via SMS OTP tokens.
sub_items.permissions: Time-bounded session window (TTL), sandboxed read-only console scope, and complete operational audit trail.
sub_items.business_value: Frictionless, secure, and touchless demonstration workflows for prospective enterprise clients.

faq_subtitle: Get answers regarding the Artron platform, IoT hardware setup, and legal compliance
faq_q1: How long does IoT turnstile installation take?
faq_a1: Physical installation and network configuration are typically completed within 1-3 business days. Our team provides full technical setup and seamless integration with the ARTRON SaaS platform.
faq_q2: How is data security and multi-tenancy isolation guaranteed?
faq_a2: Each client's (tenant's) data is strictly isolated at both logical and database levels. Sensitive personal data (e.g., National ID) is encrypted using AES-256-GCM algorithm.
faq_q3: Does the work-time tracking comply with Georgian legislation (Order №01-15/ნ)?
faq_a3: Yes, Artron's work-time tracking module fully complies with the requirements of Order №01-15/n of the Minister of Internally Displaced Persons from the Occupied Territories, Labour, Health and Social Affairs of Georgia. The system automatically generates digital timesheets for Labor Inspection audits.
faq_q4: What happens if we terminate our subscription? How is data exported (30-day rule)?
faq_a4: Upon subscription termination, operational data is retained for 30 calendar days for full export by the tenant. After 30 days, the data is permanently purged, except for financial transaction logs, which are securely archived for 3 years to comply with the Tax Code of Georgia.
faq_q5: Does the 14-day refund window apply to subscriptions purchased via the mobile app?
faq_a5: Yes, in accordance with the Georgian Law 'On the Protection of Consumer Rights', a statutory 14-day right of withdrawal and refund applies to mobile app subscriptions, provided the service utilization has not commenced.
faq_q6: How secure is the mobile QR pass? Can it be shared with others?
faq_a6: ARTRON's mobile QR pass is dynamic and automatically regenerates every 15 seconds. Screenshots cannot be used, which completely eliminates unauthorized pass sharing with third parties.
faq_q7: Does the turnstile gate work during internet outages (Offline mode)?
faq_a7: Yes, the turnstile controllers store a local cache of active credentials. Even in the event of an internet outage, authorized members and staff can enter offline, and all entrance logs will synchronize once connection is restored.

privacy_subtitle: Data protection, encryption, and biometric safety in the Artron ecosystem
privacy_sec_operator_body: The data processor is Artron LLC (Identification Code: 412799431), registered legal address: 46A Nikea St., Apt. 17, Kutaisi, Georgia. Contact email: info@artron.ge. Our cybersecurity and data protection team continuously audits our information systems to ensure the highest standards of data safety.
privacy_sec_roles_title: 2. Data Processor and Data Controller Roles
privacy_sec_roles_body: Artron LLC acts as a Technical Data Processor for information uploaded by B2B clients (fitness clubs, employers, sports complexes) including employee timesheets under Ministerial Order №01-15/n, medical codes, and athlete registries. Artron LLC acts as a Data Controller for mobile app profile fields, credentials, configurations, and system logs.
privacy_sec_security_body: All sensitive personal identifiers (such as National ID numbers) are encrypted at rest using the AES-256-GCM column-level algorithm. Passwords are encrypted using robust hashing algorithms (bcrypt/argon2). Payment processing complies fully with PCI-DSS standards; credit card data is never stored on our local servers.
privacy_sec_biometrics_body: Photos used for turnstile gate verification are classified as Biometric Data. Medical clearance records and health codes (such as leave information) represent special category health data. Their processing is restricted by strict role-based access controls (RBAC) and requires the user's explicit consent.
privacy_sec_erasure_body: Standard user account deletions requested via the app or email are fully purged from production databases within 15 calendar days. Biometric photos and special category health data are purged within 5 calendar days. Under the Tax Code of Georgia, transaction records are safely archived for 3 years before permanent disposal.
privacy_sec_rights_body: In accordance with the Georgian Law "On Personal Data Protection" and GDPR, you have the right to request access, correction, deletion, or restriction of your personal data. For requests and inquires, please contact info@artron.ge.
terms_subtitle: Rules and regulations for using the Artron website and SaaS ecosystem
terms_sec_license_body: Artron LLC grants users a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, and revocable license to access the platform via subscription. The platform source code, structure, schemas, and assets remain the exclusive intellectual property of Artron LLC. Subscriptions grant system access only and do not transfer copyright or code ownership.
terms_sec_security_body: Users are strictly prohibited from reverse-engineering the platform, attempting SQL/NoSQL injections, or deploying malicious payloads. Inputs are sanitized and validated. Violating actions will result in immediate termination of access.
terms_sec_refunds_body: Under the Georgian Law "On the Protection of Consumer Rights", a 14-day statutory right of withdrawal and refund applies to mobile app subscriptions, provided service utilization has not commenced. For B2B clients, the sports facility acts as the seller of record for memberships and must manage statutory refunds independently.
terms_sec_offboarding_body: When a B2B subscription is terminated, active operational data (schedules, customer lists) is retained for 30 calendar days to enable complete export, after which it is permanently purged. Financial logs are archived for 3 years in accordance with tax audit requirements.
terms_sec_liability_body: Artron LLC is not responsible for the contractual or physical relationship between B2B facilities and B2C athletes, including the quality of physical training. The platform is provided on an "as is" basis.
cookie_policy_subtitle: Cookie categories, consent triggers, and security compliance
cookie_policy_sec_desc_body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us remember your selected language, session identifier, and security settings.
cookie_policy_sec_categories_body: We utilize: 1. Strictly Necessary Cookies (e.g. artron_cookie_consent, session, language) which are essential for site functionality and do not require prior consent; 2. Analytics Cookies (e.g. Google Analytics) to measure site performance and visitor behavior; 3. Marketing Cookies (e.g. Google Ads) to personalize advertising.
cookie_policy_sec_consent_body: The website implements Google Consent Mode v2. By default, analytics and marketing cookies are set to "denied". They are only updated to "granted" when you select them in our Cookie Settings panel. All IP tracking is anonymized before collection.
cookie_policy_sec_apple_body: For iOS web views and mobile apps, Artron adheres to Apple App Tracking Transparency (ATT) guidelines. We do not track user behavior across third-party websites or apps without explicit device-level authorization.
cookie_policy_sec_manage_body: You can update or withdraw your consent preferences at any time by clicking the "Cookie Preferences" link in the Footer, which reopens the consent management panel.
del_acc_subtitle: Procedure for account deactivation and data erasure
del_acc_sec_overview_body: In compliance with Apple App Store and Google Play Store mandatory deletion policies, as well as the Georgian Law "On Personal Data Protection", ARTRON users have the right to request the complete deletion of their account and associated data. This page outlines our two-phase erasure protocol and allows you to initiate the deletion process directly.
del_acc_sec_protocol_body: Data erasure follows these stages: 1. Immediate Deactivation: Upon submission, your account is deactivated and access is suspended; 2. 15-day Grace Period: You may recover your account within 15 calendar days by contacting our support team; 3. 3-year Statutory Archival: According to the Tax Code of Georgia and Labor Inspection standards (including Ministerial Order №01-15/n), financial transactions and work-time logs are archived securely for 3 years before final deletion.
del_acc_sec_form_body: Fill out the form below to initiate the account deletion process. Please specify your registered email or phone number and the reason for deletion.
del_acc_check_grace: I confirm that I understand the 15-day grace period for account recovery.
del_acc_check_archival: I acknowledge the 3-year statutory tax and work-time archival requirement.
del_acc_success_desc: Your account deletion request has been registered. You will receive an email or SMS with instructions to confirm deactivation.
del_acc_error_identity: Please provide a valid email address or phone number
del_acc_error_checkboxes: Please accept both terms to proceed.
b2b_agreement_subtitle: Master Service Agreement and licensing terms between Artron LLC and tenant gyms/federations
b2b_sec_scope_body: This agreement governs access to the Artron B2B SaaS platform, which includes: 1) the Administrator Control Panel (SaaS Web Panel) for managing sports facilities, trainer commissions, and staff schedules; 2) the IoT Turnstile Relay API for hardware integrations and real-time physical access control; 3) the Integrated Athlete Mobile App (B2C Mobile Integration) enabling dynamic QR passes, instant booking, and online subscriptions for members.
b2b_sec_sla_body: Artron LLC guarantees a 99.9% monthly server uptime for all SaaS services and API endpoints. In the event of planned maintenance that might impact performance, tenants will receive a notification at least 24 hours in advance. Force majeure, local network failures at the tenant's venue, or global internet routing outages are excluded from the uptime calculation.
b2b_sec_pricing_body: Access fees are structured based on the selected tier (Starter, Pro, Enterprise) as agreed upon onboarding. Subscriptions are billed on a recurring monthly or annual pre-paid cycle. Payment is due within 5 calendar days of the new billing period. Failure to pay will result in a temporary suspension of both the SaaS control panel access and IoT turnstile sync.
b2b_sec_labor_title: 4. Compliance with Georgian Labor Inspection Order №01-15/ნ
b2b_sec_labor_body: Artron's integrated employee time-tracking module is fully compliant with Order №01-15/n of the Minister of Labour, Health and Social Affairs of Georgia. The system automatically records check-in and check-out events via physical IoT controllers, computes exact work hours, and generates standardized electronic timesheets required for labor inspection audits.
b2b_sec_dpa_body: Under this agreement, Artron acts strictly as the Data Processor for all athlete and staff records uploaded by the Tenant (the Data Controller). To ensure maximum security, all athlete Personal Identifiers (National IDs) are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM column-level encryption. Biometric verification photos and health clearance certificates are managed under strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) schemas.
b2b_sec_termination_body: Upon termination of services, the tenant has 30 calendar days to export all operational datasets (member rosters, check-in history, staff logs). After 30 days, operational data is permanently deleted from live servers. However, in compliance with the Tax Code of Georgia, all financial transaction logs and subscription billing history must be securely archived for 3 years before final deletion.
